title: Streamlined Sales Tax Governing Board: Free Sales Tax Services (Certified Service Provider program)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: Streamlined Sales Tax Governing Board, Inc. (interstate state-government organization)
reliability: Published by the organization running the program; describes eligibility rules as designed, not how many sellers use or benefit from them. No publication date shown; read 2026-11-04.
findings: Under the Certified Service Provider (CSP) contract, a "CSP-compensated seller" in a Streamlined member state gets calculation, return filing, remittance and notice/audit response services paid for by the state, at no charge to the seller, for that state.

To qualify the seller must register through the Streamlined registration system, contract with a CSP, and in the prior 12 months have no fixed place of business over 30 days, under $50,000 of property and of payroll, and under 25% of total property or payroll in the state, among other criteria.
The page states a remote seller that must collect only because it meets the state economic nexus threshold qualifies for free CSP services in that state.

CSPs may charge for states where the seller does not qualify, for non-member states, for non-taxable transaction processing above 30% of transactions, and for additional services such as accounting or consulting.
Listed certified providers offering free services: Avalara, TaxCloud, Sovos, AccurateTax, Avior; Exactor (an Intuit subsidiary) is certified but not currently offering free services.
limitations: Free services apply only in Streamlined member states (the SSTGB home page lists 24, including associate member Tennessee); large states such as California, Texas, New York and Florida are not members per that list.
Does not say how many sellers use the program or how well it works in practice; the page is silent on onboarding effort.
Contract version mentioned is 2025-2026; terms may change.
